featureByFeatureComparison.dimension: 1. Core Neural Network Architecture & Parameter Scale
featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: Genuine deep CNN: ConvNeXt-Tiny (27,832,432 trainable parameters per fold; 139.16M 5-fold ensemble) fine-tuned end-to-end on 224x224 regional crops.
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: Hybrid filter + tiny MLP: Pretrained S3FD VGG-16 face detector (22.46M frozen params) + hand-crafted Gaussian/Sobel/Hessian crease-valley filters feeding a 466-parameter 2-layer MLP (IntraratSaggingNetV6).
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Retains V2's 27.83M-param ConvNeXt-Tiny 5-fold deep classifier as the primary regional feature backbone AND runs V6's S3FD + Hessian crease-valley + 466-param MLP in parallel for fine sub-region contour localization.

featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: 88 rights-verified Meta AI synthetic portraits (SYN-M001..088) with AI_PROVISIONAL_LABEL (honestly documented as non-physician provisional labels; 0 real patients).
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: 17 test portraits in scratch/dataset with PHYSICIAN_REFERENCE_DATASET_15 hardcoded in Python code (where rater_b = rater_a + 0.2 across entries; no signed clinical rater CSVs or consent registry).
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Enforces V2's strict scientific honesty: labels V2 outputs as AI_PROVISIONAL_LABEL (88 synthetic) and V6 outputs as 17-Portrait Pilot Reference Calibration, never claiming validated dual-physician clinical trial sign-off.

featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: 4 calibrated regional bounding boxes: Cheek, Jawline, Submental (Under Chin), and Neck (median IoU 0.80–0.81 vs hand annotation).
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: 10 anatomical sub-regions: Left/Right Jowl Lobes, Jawline Contour, Left/Right Lower Cheek Descent, Left/Right Nasolabial Folds, Left/Right Marionette Lines, and Submental/Platysmal Neck.
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Combines V2's 4 calibrated deep-learning region boxes with V6's 10 pixel-level sub-region crease-valley contours and 21-point active mandibular silhouette curve.

featureByFeatureComparison.dimension: 4. Individual-Specific Contour vs. Fixed Template Boxes
featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: Computes calibrated 4-region crop boxes + 7-point/468-point MediaPipe mandibular chord excursion telemetry.
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: Extracts pixel-level anisotropic Hessian crease-valley polygons, centerlines, and a 21-point active mandibular edge curve; strictly suppresses overlays when regional severity < 0.75.
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Renders both V2's calibrated 4-region assessment zones (with <90% visibility NA masking) and V6's threshold-gated pixel-level crease-valley polygons & 21-point mandibular silhouette deflection.

featureByFeatureComparison.dimension: 5. Jawline Occlusion, Mask & Raking-Light Quality Gate
featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: Checks face count, 200px min face size, 256px Laplacian sharpness (>=15), brightness (40..220), multi-view Euler pose, and <90% frame cutoff, but does not detect surgical masks covering an in-frame jawline.
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: Detects surgical masks/hands/garments occluding the jawline (OCCLUDED_JAWLINE via chromatic skin-ratio check) and directional side raking light (DIRECTIONAL_RAKING_LIGHT_ASYMMETRY).
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Unifies both gates: V2's resolution/sharpness/Euler pose/<90% frame visibility gate + V6's OCCLUDED_JAWLINE mask gate and raking-light shadow asymmetry detector.

featureByFeatureComparison.dimension: 6. Behavior on Unseen Real-Style vs. Synthetic Portraits (Live Benchmark Findings)
featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: High accuracy on held-out synthetic portraits (e.g., SYN-M001 C:2 J:3 S:3 N:2 exact match; QWK 0.60–0.81 on J/S/N), but compresses unseen non-synthetic portraits toward Grades 1–2 and has 0% raw Grade 0 recall due to <=3 Grade 0 training images.
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: Smoothly separates young taut (SUBJ_01_26F: 0.0/4.0) from moderate (SUBJ_11_52F: 2.39/4.0) and severe (SUBJ_17_67M: 3.23/4.0) portrait lighting, but over-grades synthetic faces (SYN-M073 young graded 2.30/4.0) due to synthetic skin-shading gradients.
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Runs both models side-by-side in Authenticated Medical Reviewer Mode, adds V3 Logit-Adjusted Prior Correction for V2 rare-grade sensitivity, and flags cross-model divergence for Dr. Rushapol's Physician Review.

featureByFeatureComparison.v2_system_b: Standalone local app (D:\AI\Facial-Sagging\clinical\annotation_app\serve_annotation.py on port 8702) with Criteria Confirmation + Blinded Region-Crop Grading tabs.
featureByFeatureComparison.v6_system_a: Client-side physician override form in browser memory.
featureByFeatureComparison.unified_resolution: Integrates the 2-tab Dr. Rushapol Physician Criteria Review & Case Error Correction Studio directly into /facescan-v2/ with durable server-side persistence (GET/POST /api/face-scan-v2/physician-annotations) while keeping criteria in DRAFT status until Dr. Rushapol explicitly locks confirmation.
